claims.claim_text: The entity identifies the governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Draft text states what the entity should disclose but does not actually name/identify any governance body or individual.

claims.claim_text: Responsibilities for sustainability-related risks and opportunities are reflected in the terms of reference, mandates, role descriptions and other related policies applicable to the responsible governance body(ies) or individual(s).
claims.support_notes: No specific terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions/policies are cited or described; only a generic requirement statement is present.

claims.claim_text: The responsible governance body(ies) or individual(s) determines whether appropriate skills and competencies are available or will be developed to oversee strategies responding to sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: No description of skills/competency assessment process or development plan is provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how and how often the responsible governance body(ies) or individual(s) is informed about sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Frequency and information channels are not stated; only the requirement is listed.

claims.claim_text: The responsible governance body(ies) or individual(s) takes sustainability-related risks and opportunities into account when overseeing strategy, decisions on major transactions, and risk management processes and related policies, including consideration of trade-offs.
claims.support_notes: No concrete examples of oversight, transaction decisions, risk processes, or trade-off considerations are disclosed.

claims.claim_text: The responsible governance body(ies) or individual(s) oversees the setting of targets related to sustainability-related risks and opportunities and monitors progress, including whether and how related performance metrics are included in remuneration policies.
claims.support_notes: No targets, metrics, monitoring cadence, or remuneration linkages are described.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses management’s role in governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Draft text is a template; it does not describe actual management roles, controls, or procedures.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses whether management’s sustainability-related governance role is delegated to a specific management-level position or committee and how oversight is exercised over that position or committee.
claims.support_notes: No named position/committee or oversight mechanism is provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses whether management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related risks and opportunities and how these are integrated with other internal functions.
claims.support_notes: No controls/procedures or integration points (e.g., risk, audit, compliance) are described.

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies the governance body(ies) or individual(s) responsible for oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: No governance body/individual is actually identified in the draft.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses how and how often the responsible governance body(ies) or individual(s) is informed about climate-related risks and opportunities.

claims.claim_text: The responsible governance body(ies) or individual(s) takes climate-related risks and opportunities into account when overseeing strategy, decisions on major transactions, and risk management processes and related policies, including consideration of trade-offs.
